title: Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah hoists the Tricolour at his residence in New Delhi as part of the ‘Har Ghar Tiranga’ campaign
subtitle:
‘Har Ghar Tiranga’ campaign, launched under the leadership of Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi ji, further strengthens the sentiment of patriotism and pride in the heart of every Indian
Tiranga stands for the sacred pride we take in our nation and the might of our unity
Crores of countrymen are connecting with the Tricolour and empowering the spirit of ‘Ek Bharat, Shreshtha Bharat’
The Home Minister appealed to every citizen to unite with millions of others in this movement
Every citizen should celebrate patriotism by hoisting the Tiranga at their homes and uploading a selfie on
http://harghartiranga.com
body_text:
Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah hoisted the Tricolour at his residence in New Delhi today as part of the ‘Har Ghar Tiranga’ campaign. The Home Minister appealed to every citizen to unite with millions of others in this movement and celebrate patriotism by hoisting the Tiranga at their homes and uploading a selfie on http://harghartiranga.com .
In a post on X, Union Home Minister said, “Today, at my residence in New Delhi, I hoisted the Tricolour under the #HarGharTiranga campaign. This campaign, launched under the leadership of Modi ji, is today further strengthening the sentiment of patriotism and pride in the heart of every Indian. Today, crores of countrymen are connecting with the Tricolour and empowering the spirit of Ek Bharat, Shreshtha Bharat.”

The Home Minister said in another post on X, “The Tiranga stands for the sacred pride we take in our nation and the might of our unity. Joined the #HarGharTiranga movement by hoisting our national flag. I urge every citizen to unite with millions of others in this movement and celebrate patriotism by hoisting the Tiranga at your homes and uploading a selfie on http://harghartiranga.com .”

enrichment.summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah hoisted the national flag at his residence in New Delhi on 13 August 2026 as part of the 'Har Ghar Tiranga' campaign. He posted messages on social media describing the campaign as strengthening patriotism and the spirit of 'Ek Bharat, Shreshtha Bharat', and urged citizens to hoist the Tricolour at their homes and upload selfies on the harghartiranga.com portal.
enrichment.context: The 'Har Ghar Tiranga' campaign is a Government of India initiative, launched in 2022 under the Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav framework to mark 75 years of independence, encouraging citizens to hoist the national flag at their homes to foster a personal connection with the Tricolour and deepen the spirit of nationalism. The campaign has since become an annual feature around Independence Day, with citizens invited to upload selfies with the flag on a dedicated government portal. This particular release is a ceremonial account of a minister's participation and public appeal, without any new policy, scheme, or legal announcement.
